title: Contact/set old_state TOCTOU with multi-threaded tokio runtime
description: In contact.rs ChatContactSetHandler, old_state is captured in a dedicated lock scope that is dropped before the first process_create or process_update call (line 176-181). Each process_create/process_update then acquires its own lock scope. With tokio::main's default multi-threaded scheduler, a concurrent Peer/deliver (which calls contacts().upsert) can acquire the Mutex between the old_state drop and the first mutation, advancing the contacts state counter. This makes the oldState in the response describe a state that is no longer the state just before this call's mutations, violating RFC 8620 §5.3. Compare: ChatSetHandler in chat.rs holds the lock across old_state + all creates in one scope. MessageSetHandler uses a lazy old_state_cell captured inside the first lock scope. Contact/set should adopt one of these patterns.
